mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market participants anticipate sustained low-cost capital.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.1 percentage points indicates strengthening labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated consumer spending expectations.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines by > 0.1pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous 1% monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 1% and RSAFS rises > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 (2017=100) indicates strong manufacturing output, correlating with positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days during early-cycle economic expansions.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly consumer price index increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating inflation, triggering Federal Reserve rate hikes that produce negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises by > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points and payrolls increase exceeding 100,000 persons in one month indicate labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls by > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises by > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, housing starts exceeding 1800 thousand units per month signals sustained consumer confidence, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through continued spending momentum.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1800 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95 (2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.
